title: "Born to Save" - 2026 Christmas Concert
seo_title: Born to Save Christmas Concert in Joplin, MO – Dec 12
description: Proclamation Youth & Community Choir presents "Born to Save," a Christmas concert with a combined youth and adult choir, an orchestra, and guest musicians, following the traditional "Nine Lessons & Carols" format with old and new hymns. Guests are invited to sing on a number of selections, admission is free, and donations support the ministry of Proclamation Youth Choir. It takes place December 12, 2026 (time TBD) at College Heights Christian Church, 4311 Newman Rd in Joplin, MO.
address: College Heights Christian Church, 4311 Newman Rd, Joplin, MO 64801, United States, Joplin, MO
